title: Case 027: Blocked Bath Drain Request
initial_request: Goodmorning, I writing concerning Flat 10, bathtub and we have been experiencing some water residual after taking a shower for about 2 days now and currently the water keep take hours b4 draining. I would be glad if the maintenance guys could come take a look at it
overview: The tenant reported that the bath was draining slowly after showers. Northbridge Lettings advised trying a drain cleaner and plunger, explaining that internal drain blockages caused by everyday use were the tenant’s responsibility and that a contractor visit could be chargeable. After follow-up messages, the tenant said a plunger had cleared the drain. The task was recorded as resolved without a contractor and completed without payment. Later correspondence in the same record concerned the tenant’s separate question about registering for a garage parking space; block management had been contacted, with further information to follow.
outcome: The tenant confirmed that they had cleared the bath blockage themselves using a plunger. The request was completed without a contractor or payment.

Job Id: NBL-027-8010
Address: Flat 10, 30 Copperfield Walk, Willowbank, ZZ2 3ZZ

Hi there,

I hope you are well.

Thank you for bringing the blocked bath/shower drain to our attention.

As per the terms of your tenancy, maintenance of internal drains—including clearing blockages caused by everyday use such as hair or soap build-up is the tenant’s responsibility. We kindly recommend that you try using a strong drain cleaner and a plunger to attempt to dislodge whatever may be causing the blockage.

Should this not resolve the issue, you are welcome to arrange for a plumber to attend at your own cost. Alternatively, we can organise a contractor to attend on your behalf; however, please note that if the blockage is found to be due to tenant-related causes such as hair, foreign objects, or general shower usage, the full cost of the call-out and repair will be billed to you.

Please let us know how you would like to proceed.

Kind regards,
